method: per-criterion median across three judges, then weighted by the rubric

notes.problem: A lit mid-grey floor in the bottom half; the cite on a plate.
notes.fix: Kill the floor fill, pool the lamp under the column bases, remove the plate.

notes.problem: Two cylinders on a grey studio cyc with the lower half in mid grey; the cite on a plate.
notes.fix: Wet black asphalt bank under the lamp, backlit columns, ground near black outside the pool, no plate.

notes.problem: A lit mid-grey floor under two primitive cylinders.
notes.fix: Kill the floor fill, a tight pool under the bases, backlight the water.

notes.problem: A knoll of primitives with an empty dark top half; the cost bar is the brightest object.
notes.fix: Drop to 0.6 m and push in so the enclosure, the lensed rail and the panel fill the lower two thirds at true size; sink the bar as a thin lit inlay.

notes.problem: Primitives in a flat row unidentifiable at 432 px, a hard shelf edge, an empty top 45%, a ghost arc, the built node cropped into the counter.
notes.fix: A true knolling view with identifiable chassis parts in the pool with contact shadows; remove the shelf edge and arc; move the built node clear.

notes.problem: An empty band between dek and parts; abstract discs, slabs and a bar; the rail cut off at the right.
notes.fix: Drop the eye and push in so the sensors, enclosure and panel fill the lower half; cut the shield discs; lay the bar in the pool.

notes.problem: A brown low-poly bank wedge, red tail lamps, the gauge arm crossing the cab, a near-black pickup.
notes.fix: Slide the pickup left, rim-light it, dull the tail lamps, replace the wedge with a dark scattered bank.

notes.problem: A black pickup on black, the gauge over its cab, reading as parked.
notes.fix: Rim the pickup from the lamp, slide the node right, yaw the truck so its headlights sweep up the grade.

notes.problem: A hairline pole; the SOLAR PANEL and TEMPERATURE leaders' horizontals nearly share a line.
notes.fix: Bring the camera in to a third of the width; route the temperature leader at least 40 px below the solar leader.

notes.problem: The node about 190 px wide, its lower rail dissolving into haze, a fragment under the footer.
notes.fix: Move the camera in about 30%, light the lower rail and its wake, remove the fragment.

notes.problem: A flat grey lit slab in the bottom third.
notes.fix: Tighten the pool to the column's base so the slab falls to black within half a metre.

notes.problem: A flat mid-grey floor with a straight horizon, the pool left of the column, streaks in the glass.
notes.fix: Aim the pool at the column base, darken the slab outside it, delete the in-glass streaks.

notes.problem: A grey bar with one orange donut at feed size, no waterline context.
notes.fix: Pull back to the waterline so three sensors, the water surface and the reflection show.

notes.problem: A near-plain grey box reading as clay.
notes.fix: Model glands, a gasket lip and a label plate, rake the lamp low across the lid, add grime streaks.

notes.problem: A square asphalt corner, an unworn stripe, a ground glow for the planned ring.
notes.fix: Break and dim the edge line into the water, feather the asphalt under a foam line, a small halo on the first ring.

rounds_source: this module's own log of cards it has scored

craft_note: at the round cap the craft floor stands down. The art median 6.6 is under 8.5 and the deck ships as it is. Name it in the run record
